text:
[issue by Popchip9]
### Describe the bug

Version 19.2.17
Templates when created as a recipe always display missing ingredients

### How to reproduce the bug

create pattern for netherite upgrade smithing template and attempt to autocraft it

### Expected behavior

Not failing to register ingredients, i think its the smithing templates themselves it cant register

### Additional details

_No response_

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge

### Crash log

.

[comment by Mithi83 (collaborator)]
Are you talking about the recipe to make more smithing templates if you have one? In this case have a look at the section "Recursive Recipes" in the guide: https://guide.appliedenergistics.org/1.21.1/ae2-mechanics/autocrafting that explains why it is not possible in the most intuitive way and also links to a more complex solution here https://guide.appliedenergistics.org/1.21.1/example-setups/recursive-crafting-setup
